headline: Astemo Faces Severe Production Halt Due to Cyberattack on Factory Network
body: Hitachi Astemo, Ltd., now known as Astemo, Ltd., reported a significant disruption in its operations following a malware attack targeting their factory networks. This incident forced a temporary cessation of several critical manufacturing processes across their facilities, affecting tools used in production lines. The company is diligently working on rebuilding compromised systems and anticipates a phased restart of operations. Although the malware's impact is clear, no public confirmation of a ransom demand has been issued.
